title: LayoutSlabReinforcement
description: LayoutSlabReinforcement: Slab reinforcement for a floor configuration where the layout of the reinforcement has been explicitly defined.

Reinforcement.description:
Reinforcement intent for the slab, defining the layout of the reinforcement by region. Extents are normalized. PanelRebarIntent: A collection of PanelReinforcement objects that represent the rebar intent. 
This is stored as layers of reinforcement amongst regions within the Panel.
